text.p: The following are leading domestic stories in Portuguese newspapers.
- Opposition Social Democratic Party (PSD) seeks meeting with Interior Minister Alberto Costa having accused him of failing to provide a security policy.
- Industrial group Sonae plans to expand in Brazil and southern Africa, senior Sonae official Carlos Moreira da Silva told the paper.

- Portugal received looted Nazi gold, laundered in Switzerland, during World War Two that would be worth 200 billion escudos at today's prices, according to a U.S. State Department document made available to the newspaper.
- Lisbon port workers demand 4.5 percent pay rise for 1997, but managemement offering three percent.
- Economy and Finance Ministries differ over how to resolve problems of loss-making ship repairer Lisnave.
